fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting on Dade County grand jury matters and criticism of Circuit Judge Stanley Milledge, including discussion of alleged graft and calls for the grand jury to demand evidence. Coverage includes Miami police and gambling enforcement, commentary on local newspapers and press practices (including a dispute involving Commissioner H. Leslie Quigg and attorney Abe Aronovitz, with reference to statements attributed to Elmer Davis and John S. Knight), and local politics including Florida Power & Light rate-setting and municipal ownership proposals. Additional items address liquor-related offenses and traffic incidents, hotel licensing statistics, local human-interest stories, entertainment/nightlife columns and club openings, and summaries of divorce filings drawn from Dade County courthouse records.
